description: A mouth on a tendon: a muscular cord anchored in the Eyebark canopy with a free-hanging jaw at the end of it, slack until something walks underneath. Shelter from the sky under the trees is not safe from this.
departures: The body is a bare muscular cord like a stretched tendon: no scales, no torso, and no thickening into a trunk anywhere along it
The upper end is rooted directly into the Eyebark canopy, so it does not coil or wrap around a branch the way a hanging snake does
The free end is just a jaw with no head behind it: no eyes, no skull shape, no neck
It hangs slack and straight down under its own weight, not in S-curves or a raised, poised strike pose
It has no limbs and no tail tip; the cord runs from the anchor point to the jaw and nothing else
